'''Jagged Fang''' was the name of a particularly strong and dangerous [[Varactyl/Legends|varactyl]] that lived on the planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It could be found in the jungles near the city of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]], where the planet wasn't completely covered with kilometer-high [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|wroshyr trees]].

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], a [[Beastmaster/Legends|beast master]] who wanted to obtain a varactyl egg to train one of these creatures was sent to a varactyl nesting place by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Pirus Gue]]. The adventurer had to fight and kill Jagged Fang who guarded the eggs savagely.
